description: This PHP source file manages the Wi-Fi network configuration interface for a web UI. It includes PHP code for setting Wi-Fi parameters, including SSIDs, security modes, and channels, along with embedded JavaScript for dynamic UI interactions and AJAX calls. The file appears to generate a web page allowing users to view and modify wireless network settings, including WPS, band steering, and radio modes.

methods.name: check_add
methods.description: Validates user input for adding a device, checking device name and MAC address formats.

methods.name: add_row
methods.description: Dynamically adds a row to a specified table for managing device filters or auto-learned devices.

methods.name: del_row
methods.description: Removes a specified row from a table after user confirmation.

methods.name: save_filter
methods.description: Saves the current Wi-Fi control list filtering configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Saves wireless configuration parameters for a specified SSID.

methods.name: save_enable
methods.description: Saves the enabled/disabled state of wireless radios and WPS settings via AJAX.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates a WPS PIN checksum according to the IEEE 802.11 standard.

methods.name: pair_client
methods.description: Initiates a WPS pairing with a client device through AJAX.

methods.name: pair_cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing process after user confirmation through AJAX.

methods.name: showSteeringHistoryDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with bandwidth steering history records.

methods.name: steering_history
methods.description: Fetches and displays band steering history information via AJAX.

methods.name: saveBandSteeringSettings
methods.description: Saves the band steering configuration settings through AJAX.
